; Stickerz 1.0 - QML-only sticker go/return buttons for reMarkable Paper Pro 3.28 (no native code).
; Author: Nick Greenfield
; Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (credits include GPL-2.0-or-later research — see README).
; Document open / page-jump calls follow alefaraci's linkFromSelection (GPL-3.0-only):
;   research/alefaraci/3.28/linkFromSelection.qmd
; Overlay INSERT into DocumentView follows the same AFFECT/TRAVERSE as that mod and rm-stickers v3.1.
; Cross-document return state is stored as primitives on the long-lived root
; ~&254540341572282132&~ (same object linkFromSelection uses for regCrossPick / regCrossJump),
; NOT on the DocumentView instance (which is destroyed when the notebook switches).
; Every hashed token below is copied from mods published for 3.28 (see README "Evidence").
; Icons are drawn with plain QtQuick Canvas (no new hashes): peeled sticker (open) and
; left-arrow + lined page (back). Based on Nick's chosen options C and 4.

AFFECT [[8850026134298937527]]
	TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]
	LOCATE BEFORE ALL
	INSERT {
		/* Primitives on the long-lived root (same pattern as linkFromSelection's regCrossPick). */
		property string stkBackDoc: ""
		property int stkBackPage: 0
		property int stkJump: -1
		property string stkJumpDoc: ""
		property int stkLastCat: 0
		function stkOpenDoc(docId, pageIdx) {
			try {
				var d = ~&233694067165438&~.~&8399431778896295215&~(docId);
				if (!d) return "Library notebook not found - is 'Stickers' in My files?";
				if (d.~&7712810854541167&~) return "Notebook not downloaded yet";
				~&254540341572282132&~.stkJumpDoc = docId;
				~&254540341572282132&~.stkJump = pageIdx;
				~&254540341572282132&~.~&9497240032101537789&~(d, pageIdx);
				return "";
			} catch (e) { return "Could not open: " + e; }
		}
		function stkClearBack() {
			~&254540341572282132&~.stkBackDoc = "";
			~&254540341572282132&~.stkBackPage = 0;
		}
	}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT [[11806562588218124596]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
	LOCATE AFTER ALL
	INSERT {
		Item {
			id: stkLayer
			anchors.fill: parent
			z: 99999
			property string libId: "5d1c4e2a-57ac-4b3a-9f00-000000000000"
			property var cats: ["Dates", "Decor", "Doodles", "Labels", "Life", "Mood", "Nature", "Plan", "Seasons"]
			property string msg: ""
			property string docIdNow: {
				var d = ~&6504254477&~.~&7712934851008712&~;
				return (d && d.~&5972374&~) ? String(d.~&5972374&~) : "";
			}
			property int pageNow: {
				try { return ~&6504254477&~.~&6504167078&~; } catch (e) { return 0; }
			}
			property bool inLib: docIdNow === libId
			function openDoc(id, pageIdx) {
				var err = ~&254540341572282132&~.stkOpenDoc(id, pageIdx);
				if (err !== "") { msg = err; return false; }
				return true;
			}
			property int jumpTries: 0
			function tryJump() {
				var want = ~&254540341572282132&~.stkJump;
				if (want < 0) return;
				if (!~&6504254477&~.~&7712934851008712&~) return;
				if (docIdNow !== ~&254540341572282132&~.stkJumpDoc) { if (++jumpTries > 20) { ~&254540341572282132&~.stkJump = -1; jumpTries = 0; } return; }
				~&254540341572282132&~.stkJump = -1; jumpTries = 0;
				if (pageNow === want) return;
				try { ~&6504254477&~.~&7713405014271992&~(want, ~&14175747548438644067&~.~&10593835380864769165&~.~&7442916920529273295&~); } catch (e) { msg = "Page jump failed: " + e; }
			}
			Timer { interval: 250; repeat: true; running: ~&254540341572282132&~.stkJump >= 0; onTriggered: stkLayer.tryJump() }
			Component.onCompleted: tryJump()
			function gotoLibrary() {
				if (inLib) {
					msg = "Already in Stickers - lasso a sticker, Copy, then tap Back";
					return;
				}
				~&254540341572282132&~.stkBackDoc = docIdNow;
				~&254540341572282132&~.stkBackPage = pageNow;
				var pageIdx = ~&254540341572282132&~.stkLastCat;
				if (pageIdx < 0 || pageIdx >= cats.length) pageIdx = 0;
				openDoc(libId, pageIdx);
			}
			function goBack() {
				var doc = ~&254540341572282132&~.stkBackDoc;
				var page = ~&254540341572282132&~.stkBackPage;
				if (!doc || doc === "") {
					msg = "No return document - use the X to close Stickers";
					return;
				}
				try { ~&254540341572282132&~.stkLastCat = pageNow; } catch (e) {}
				~&254540341572282132&~.stkClearBack();
				openDoc(doc, page);
			}
			Timer { id: stkMsgTimer; interval: 3500; running: stkLayer.msg !== ""; onTriggered: stkLayer.msg = "" }

			/* Sticker button: top-right. Icon C — peeled sticker (Canvas, no new hashes). */
			Rectangle {
				id: stkGo
				visible: !stkLayer.inLib
				width: 88; height: 88; radius: 12
				anchors.top: parent.top
				anchors.topMargin: 16
				anchors.right: parent.right
				anchors.rightMargin: 120
				color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
				Canvas {
					id: stkGoIcon
					anchors.fill: parent
					anchors.margins: 14
					onPaint: {
						var ctx = getContext("2d");
						var w = width, h = height;
						ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
						ctx.strokeStyle = "#000000";
						ctx.fillStyle = "#000000";
						ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2.5, w / 18);
						ctx.lineJoin = "round";
						ctx.lineCap = "round";
						var s = w / 160;
						function X(x) { return x * s; }
						function Y(y) { return y * s; }
						/* body: square with bottom-right corner cut for fold */
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(30), Y(30));
						ctx.lineTo(X(130), Y(30));
						ctx.lineTo(X(130), Y(95));
						ctx.lineTo(X(95), Y(130));
						ctx.lineTo(X(30), Y(130));
						ctx.closePath();
						ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
						ctx.fill();
						ctx.stroke();
						/* fold triangle, light grey */
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(130), Y(95));
						ctx.lineTo(X(95), Y(95));
						ctx.lineTo(X(95), Y(130));
						ctx.closePath();
						ctx.fillStyle = "#c8c8c8";
						ctx.fill();
						ctx.stroke();
					}
					Component.onCompleted: requestPaint()
					onWidthChanged: requestPaint()
					onHeightChanged: requestPaint()
				}
				MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: stkLayer.gotoLibrary() }
			}

			/* Back button: same place. Icon 4 — left arrow + lined document page. */
			Rectangle {
				id: stkBackBtn
				visible: stkLayer.inLib
				width: 88; height: 88; radius: 12
				anchors.top: parent.top
				anchors.topMargin: 16
				anchors.right: parent.right
				anchors.rightMargin: 120
				color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
				Canvas {
					id: stkBackIcon
					anchors.fill: parent
					anchors.margins: 14
					onPaint: {
						var ctx = getContext("2d");
						var w = width, h = height;
						ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
						ctx.strokeStyle = "#000000";
						ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
						ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2.5, w / 18);
						ctx.lineJoin = "round";
						ctx.lineCap = "round";
						var s = w / 160;
						function X(x) { return x * s; }
						function Y(y) { return y * s; }
						/* lined document page on the right */
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.rect(X(70), Y(25), X(130) - X(70), Y(135) - Y(25));
						ctx.fill();
						ctx.stroke();
						ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, w / 36);
						for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
							var y = 45 + i * 18;
							ctx.beginPath();
							ctx.moveTo(X(82), Y(y));
							ctx.lineTo(X(118), Y(y));
							ctx.stroke();
						}
						/* left arrow pointing at the page */
						ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, w / 14);
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(20), Y(80));
						ctx.lineTo(X(62), Y(80));
						ctx.stroke();
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(20), Y(80));
						ctx.lineTo(X(40), Y(62));
						ctx.stroke();
						ctx.beginPath();
						ctx.moveTo(X(20), Y(80));
						ctx.lineTo(X(40), Y(98));
						ctx.stroke();
					}
					Component.onCompleted: requestPaint()
					onWidthChanged: requestPaint()
					onHeightChanged: requestPaint()
				}
				MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: stkLayer.goBack() }
			}

			Rectangle {
				visible: stkLayer.msg !== ""
				anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
				anchors.top: parent.top
				anchors.topMargin: 120
				width: stkMsgText.implicitWidth + 48; height: 72; radius: 12
				color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
				z: 1
				Text { id: stkMsgText; anchors.centerIn: parent; text: stkLayer.msg; font.pixelSize: 28; color: "black" }
			}
		}
	}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
